Calculations.Name: Copied trades count once per participating account
Calculations.Detail: Lead $10K + follower $5K: 1 trade each, All funded 2 trades / +$500; activation capital not a gain

Calculations.Detail: Equity $0 → 3× notices/steps/reconciles + rebuild + liquidation: 1 blown attempt, −$5,000, 1 trade

Calculations.Name: Restarts keep lifetime losses and blown attempts; current attempt starts fresh

Calculations.Detail: 75 closes with 60 retained rows: 75 trades, 50W/25L, net +$1,250 = ledger
